passage.label: Ha-Meem; revelation from Allah Exalted Might Wise; heavens earth signs believers; creation yourselves dispersed moving creatures signs certain; alternation night day provision sky gives life earth directing winds signs reason; verses Allah recited truth what statement after Allah verses believe; woe sinful liar; hears verses persists arrogantly as if not heard tidings painful punishment; knows anything verses takes ridicule humiliating punishment; before them Hell earned not avail taken besides Allah allies great punishment; Quran guidance disbelieved verses Lord painful punishment foul nature

arabicExcerpts.text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ

mainSubject.label: Opening letters and the Book's origin in the Mighty Wise; five cosmic and human signs enumerated for believers, the certain and those who reason — heavens and earth, self-creation and dispersed creatures, night-day alternation, sky-provision reviving dead earth, and wind-direction; these declared Allah's verses recited in truth with the challenge of what post-divine statement they will believe; woe pronounced on every sinful liar who hears verses yet persists arrogantly or ridicules known portions, earning painful and humiliating punishment; Hell positioned ahead while earnings and adopted allies prove useless against great punishment; the Quran named guidance while disbelievers face a foul-natured painful penalty

notes: Wave 7 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the foul-natured punishment declaration (11) before the subjection-and-forgiveness block opens (12); P2 ends with the truth-based creation affirmation (22) before the desire-as-god critique begins (23); P3 runs from that critique through the kneeling nations, record, reciprocal forgetting and the closing praise (23-37).
